name: Filesystem MCP
description: Read/write access to a scoped filesystem root. Standard reference server from the Anthropic MCP registry.

declaredTools.name: read_file
declaredTools.description: Read a UTF-8 file by absolute path within the scoped root.

declaredTools.name: write_file
declaredTools.description: Write UTF-8 content to a path within the scoped root.

name: Postgres MCP
description: Read-only SQL query surface over a scoped Postgres database. Includes schema introspection and safe LIMIT enforcement.

declaredTools.name: query
declaredTools.description: Execute a read-only SELECT query with a safe LIMIT applied.

declaredTools.name: describe_schema
declaredTools.description: Return the schema of the connected database.

name: Git MCP
description: Read git history and diffs for a scoped local repository. No push capability by default.

declaredTools.name: git_log
declaredTools.description: Show commit log for a scoped repo.

name: GitHub MCP
description: Read-only GitHub API surface (issues, PRs, repos) scoped by a GitHub PAT.

declaredTools.name: search_issues
declaredTools.description: Search issues across a repo or org.

declaredTools.name: get_pr
declaredTools.description: Get a pull request by number.

name: Slack MCP
description: Post messages and read channel history from Slack. Requires OAuth token scoped per workspace.

declaredTools.name: post_message
declaredTools.description: Post a message to a Slack channel.

declaredTools.name: read_channel
declaredTools.description: Read message history from a Slack channel.

name: OpenClaw Legal MCP
description: First-party MCP exposing OpenClaw's legal clause draft + counsel + KB retrieval over the MCP protocol.

declaredTools.name: clause_draft
declaredTools.description: Draft a legal clause from intake fields; returns vault-written pair_id.

declaredTools.name: counsel_answer
declaredTools.description: Route a legal question through OpenClaw's counsel pipeline.

declaredTools.name: kb_search
declaredTools.description: Semantic search over legal KB (CUAD + curated corpus).

name: OpenClaw Robustness MCP
description: Query the OpenClaw agent-robustness benchmark corpus over MCP — models, categories, per-run drill-down, leaderboard.

declaredTools.name: leaderboard
declaredTools.description: Top-N models by pass_rate on a category filter.

declaredTools.name: runs
declaredTools.description: Filtered stress runs (model, category, domain, perturbation_id).
